text:
Nora: Noticing a cluster of checksum mismatches on local NVMe in europe-west1 during the last two maintenance windows. Seems tied to thermal throttling spikes on nodes that also saw a networking flap.

infra-bot: alert: region=europe-west1 nodes=gnode-824,gnode-833 metric=nvme_crc_rate=0.12% window=45m

Diego: Any hardware sensor logs? Thermal + retry pattern could indicate controller-induced metadata corruption under high temp.

Nora: Posting sensor snippet: `temp_sensor[0]=85C -> fan ramp -> io_retries increase -> nvme: metadata CRC mismatch` The net flap earlier caused scrub jobs to requeue and overlap with high read reclaim.

Sasha: So it's a combined stress: network hiccup -> scrub restart -> janitor/deep-scrub overlap -> drive heats up from continuous retries -> CRCs surface. Low probability chain but we hit it in a small cohort.

Diego: Short-term: 1) Float those gnodes out of burst pool (avoid-new-attaches). 2) Pause deep-scrub and stagger janitor waves for the next 12h in europe-west1. 3) Add thermal backoff to scrub: if temp > 80C, back off scrub for 30m.

Nora: Implemented avoid-new-attaches tag and paused deep-scrub. infra-bot shows alerts down after 15m.

infra-bot: mitigation: avoid_new_attaches applied; deep_scrub_paused hosts=gnode-824,gnode-833; monitor=enabled

Sasha: Capacity impact: losing ~160 GPUs of burst capacity. Recommend routing small non-latency-critical attaches to europe-west2 for 6h while we monitor.

Diego: Long-term items: firmware cohort for controllers showing high temp retries, add thermal-aware scrub scheduling, and add a network-flap guard that delays scrub restarts by randomized jitter to avoid overlap. Put these in storage backlog.

Nora: I'll upload controller logs + SMART to s3://redwood-debug/eu-west1/thermal-crc/ and open lifecycle tickets for drives hitting repeated CRCs.

Sasha: Also a tiny attach improvement: if device reports repeated read retries in last 5m, mark as transient-degraded so provisioner skips it quickly. Low-risk change.

Nora: Monitoring for 6h. Early numbers: CRC events down ~75% after throttle + pause. Will post short note to #postmortems later.

Diego: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
